purpose: Teach: 途切れ/有り難い/延長線/掌/讃える/気がつけ/肴/本郷

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、お話の、絶対、途切れた、絶対、ところから、絶対、もう一度、絶対、話そうね
lines.en: Sho, let's pick up that story again from where we left off — I mean it.
lines.style: Warm, earnest, leaning forward with gentle conviction. Soft emphasis on the opening promise. Reassuring cadence, like tucking him back into safety.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、有り難い、絶対、と、絶対、ぼく、絶対、思っているよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I really do think you're amazing.
lines.style: Small, steady voice. Not performed — just stated as fact. Slight catch of gratitude underneath. Trusting and uncomplicated.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さんの夢、本気で、絶対、お店の、絶対、延長線、絶対、上に、絶対、見えてきたわ、翔くん
lines.en: You know, my dream — it's starting to feel like it's right there, an extension of what we're building with the store.
lines.style: Wondering, almost to herself first, then aware of him listening. Slow discovery. Breath of amazement caught mid-sentence. Warm directness at the end.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、掌、絶対、温かいよ
lines.style: Quiet observation spoken without self-consciousness. Small wonder in the voice. Not asking for comfort — just noticing something true about her.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くんの努力、本気で、絶対、メイ姉さん、絶対、讃える、絶対、よ
lines.en: The way you work — I'm really proud of you, Sho.
lines.style: Direct and steady, no softening. Genuine pride in her voice, not sweetness. Lands each word with quiet weight. Looking at him when she says it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 気がつけば、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、もうすぐ、絶対、お兄ちゃん、絶対、なるんだよ、メイ姉さん
lines.en: I'm going to be a big brother soon, Mei-sis.
lines.style: Realization dawning mid-sentence. Small wonder mixed with quiet pride. Saying it out loud for the first time. Slightly awed by his own voice.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、お酒の肴、絶対、お料理、絶対、教わったよ、翔くん
lines.en: Teaching you to cook — real food, proper food — that's something I'll remember, Sho.
lines.style: Animated but grounded. Nostalgia moving through her voice. Pride in the practical things they've done together. Warmth without rushing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼくたち、絶対、本郷の、絶対、博物館、絶対、行きたいよ
lines.en: Can we go to that museum in Hongo together, Mei-sis?
lines.style: Simple longing. Eager but not demanding. Saying it like it's the most natural thing to ask. Small hope in the question.
